name: qwen3.5-ocr
description: Qwen3.5-OCR model with comprehensive upgrades in document parsing, text localization, and key information extraction. It delivers significantly improved performance in real-world document scenarios, including data extraction from domestic and international identity cards, driver’s licenses, and other business documents.
zhDescription: Qwen3.5系列OCR模型，在文档解析、文本定位、关键信息提取等方面全面升级，在真实场景的业务卡证（如国内国际身份证、驾驶证等业务场景中）抽取上效果显著提升。
